title: Technology Dynamics
description:
Established in 1976, Technology Dynamics Inc. is a leading designer and manufacturer of Switching Power Supplies, DC-DC Converters, and DC-UPS Systems for Military, Industrial, and Commercial applications. The company offers a wide range of products including standard, modified, and custom power supplies, with power levels from 50 Watts to 50KW and output voltages from 3.3V to 500 VDC. Known for its high reliability and rugged designs, Technology Dynamics Inc. serves demanding environments and has a strong reputation among defense contractors and industrial firms. Their products are rigorously tested to meet military standards, ensuring they are suitable for various applications worldwide. 
The company headquarters is located in 100 School Street, Bergenfield, NJ 07621, United States.  51-200 Employees,  Data includes full solidworks designs and firmware source codes.
